description: This file manages channel test configurations, including test path patterns, root directories, and filtering logic for channel-related test files within a project. It exports constants and functions to identify test files based on path patterns and roots, primarily for channel testing in various integrations like Discord, Slack, Signal, etc.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Normalizes a file path to use forward slashes, regardless of operating system.

methods.name: isChannelSurfaceTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file path corresponds to a channel surface test file, based on configured path prefixes and exclusions.
